response.overview: Dukhyun, who started as a child actor at the age of 6 and is now 28 years old, continues his acting career with the dream of becoming a superstar.  Even though the ideal and reality are somewhat different, Dukhyun lives his daily life without losing his bright appearance.  Attachment to the past and longing for the future go hand in hand. Furthermore, the longing for what he wants to gain and the longing for what he has lost surround him at the same time.  A mysterious ‘something’ continues to follow Dukhyn around.  I can't tell if Dukhyun is trying to pretend not to know this or if he doesn't realize it.  For Dukhyun, who seems to be losing something as an actor and as a son, this 'something' seems to be something he can never lose.  How will the future unfold for these two?
response.title: SuperStar-628
